crossRefs.note: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give…
They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions…
The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
These are the names of the sons of Levi according to their generations: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari; and the years…
The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
translations.bsb: Now these were the Levites numbered by their clans: The Gershonite clan from Gershon, the Kohathite clan from Kohath, and the Merarite clan from Merari.
translations.kjv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
translations.asv: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
